Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Ashok Mukherjee. I am a 39-year-old hardware dealer living in Coimbatore. My spouse Naveen Menon and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of Rs 70,80,000, and the spouses agree on a single payment instead of maintenance. My case number is Petition No. 2758/2021 in the Family Court at Coimbatore. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 91313 12138 or email ashok.mukherjee@example.in.
